title: skills_test's 'every ticfac <command> the skill names exists' loop is vacuous
description:
internal/cli/skills_test.go:269-288 splits SKILL.md on whitespace, so '`ticfac init`' becomes '`ticfac' (trimmed to bare ticfac, skipped) and 'init`' (no prefix); no subcommand is ever checked, and a SKILL.md naming a nonexistent command passes. Also, no --json test checks a schema field (cloud trace --json emits none, cloud_trace.go:392).
